description: Get one listing: manifest with input and output schema, price per result, and live reliability. The response includes a pricing_summary with price_per_1k_usd and the recent success_rate over the stated window (7 days), read from the listing record, and a health block (health_state: healthy, degraded, unverified or failing; success_rate_7d, sample_size, last_success_at), so check it before buying. unverified means too few measured runs, not healthy. Free and keyless; nothing is run or charged.
name: alterlab_store_get
title: Get Data Store Listing
